parts.original_hypothesis: Root: P(churn) = sigmoid(-1.729 + linear_backbone + state_offsets + usage_service_nonlinear + minor_hinges), additive in logit; the four children never feed each other. 26 unconnected inputs (24 state one-hots, areaCode:510, totalEveCalls, totalEveCharge, totalIntlMinutes, totalIntlCalls and others) are zero-effect entries. Evidence (train, 4,000 rows): AUC 0.908, acc 0.909. Mean-ablation AUC: linear_backbone -> 0.826, usage_service_nonlinear -> 0.709, state_offsets -> 0.902, minor_hinges -> 0.908. reference_patient.definition: the typical patient: the median training patient for every number and the most common training category for every category (not a real patient)

confidence_rules.clearly: a meaningful change in predicted risk for a typical patient (at least 5% points), the test split agrees (same sign, and its bootstrap interval over test patients excludes no benefit), and every group has at least 20 training patients

confidence_rules.on the training data only: the test split disagrees (opposite sign, or no benefit on test patients) or is unclear (its interval includes no benefit), or no test check is available
confidence_rules.slightly: the change in predicted risk for a typical patient is below 5% points
confidence_rules.the model has little data on this: a compared group has fewer than 20 training patients
